PointDetailRead.description:
One point, with the price schedules its connectors are charged by.

Separate from ``PointRead`` because ``GET /points`` takes a bbox and has no
limit: resolving bands for every connector in a viewport would serve a list
that shows none of them.
PointDetailRead.title: PointDetailRead

PricingKind.description:
How a connector charges, right now, by the bands that apply to it.

``UNKNOWN`` covers no tariff, no band matching the present moment, and a
price the source published outside any plausible range.
PricingKind.title: PricingKind
